1.heading: 1. Minimum Order Quantity (MOQ)
1.body: Each product has a different minimum order quantity, ranging from 10 to 48 units. The MOQ is clearly stated on each product page. We offer flexible MOQ for customers starting a business.

2.heading: 2. Volume Discounts
2.body: Wholesale discounts increase with order quantity. Larger orders receive greater discounts. Detailed discount rates are included in each order quote.

3.heading: 3. Quotation and Payment
3.body: Quotes are sent within 24 business hours of receiving a request. Quotes are valid for 7 days. Payment by bank transfer, COD, or agreed methods.

4.heading: 4. Shipping and Delivery
4.body: We ship nationwide with standard export packaging. Delivery takes 2-5 business days depending on region. Shipping costs are calculated by weight and destination.

5.heading: 5. Warranty and Returns
5.body: All products are 100% authentic. Manufacturer defects are eligible for exchange or refund within 7 days of receipt. Please inspect goods upon delivery.

6.heading: 6. Wholesale Customer Support
6.body: Wholesale customers receive product consultation, marketing images, product materials, and market information. Our team is ready to support your business.

1.heading: 1. Information Collection
1.body: We collect contact information (name, phone, email, Zalo, address) and order information that you voluntarily provide via quote requests or direct contact.

2.heading: 2. Information Use
2.body: Information is used solely for quoting, product consultation, and wholesale order processing. We do not use your information for unrelated marketing.

3.heading: 3. Information Security
3.body: Customer information is stored securely and kept confidential. We do not share, sell, or rent personal information to third parties.

4.heading: 4. Your Rights
4.body: You have the right to access, correct, or delete your personal information at any time. Contact us via Zalo or email to exercise this right.

1.heading: 1. Return Conditions
1.body: Products can be exchanged or returned for manufacturer defects, wrong products, or quantity mismatches. Requests must be submitted within 7 days of receipt.

2.heading: 2. Return Process
2.body: Contact us via Zalo or hotline with order details and a description of the issue. We will guide you through the return process and proceed with exchange or refund.

3.heading: 3. Notes
3.body: Returned products must retain original labels, packaging, and condition. Shipping costs are borne by the party at fault. We ensure prompt and transparent processing.
